mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(remaining_amount), 0) from ai_credit_batch where user_id = #{userId} and remaining_amount > 0 and (expire_time is null or expire_time > sysdate())

select batch_id, user_id, source_type, source_id, total_amount, remaining_amount, expire_time, remark, create_time, update_time from ai_credit_batch where user_id = #{userId} and remaining_amount > 0 and (expire_time is null or expire_time > sysdate()) order by case when expire_time is null then 1 else 0 end, expire_time asc, batch_id asc for update

select batch_id, user_id, source_type, source_id, total_amount, remaining_amount, expire_time, remark, create_time, update_time from ai_credit_batch where user_id = #{userId} and remaining_amount > 0 and expire_time is not null and expire_time <= sysdate() order by expire_time asc, batch_id asc for update
mapper.update: update ai_credit_batch set remaining_amount = 0, update_time = sysdate() where batch_id = #{batchId} and remaining_amount > 0
mapper.select: select r.record_id, r.user_id, r.change_type, r.amount, r.balance_after, r.related_type, r.related_id, t.model as task_model, t.status as task_status, case when t.finish_time is null then null else timestampdiff(second, t.create_time, t.finish_time) end as task_duration_seconds, r.remark, r.create_time from ai_credit_record r left join ai_generation_task t on r.related_type = 'GENERATION' and t.task_id = cast(r.related_id as unsigned) where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.create_time desc, r.record_id desc limit #{limit}
